question: What were total sales in 2024?
dax: EVALUATE ROW("Total Sales", CALCULATE([Total Sales], DimDate[Year] = 2024), "Total Quantity", CALCULATE([Total Quantity], DimDate[Year] = 2024), "Orders", CALCULATE([Orders], DimDate[Year] = 2024))
note: Companion volume measures (Total Quantity, Orders) returned alongside revenue.

question: Sales by product category
dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(DimProduct[CategoryName], "Total Sales", [Total Sales], "% of Total Sales", [% of Total Sales]) ORDER BY [Total Sales] DESC
note: Breakdown by the default product dimension; % of Total Sales shows mix. Category values are in Spanish.

question: Margin % by store country
dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(DimStore[CountryName], "Gross Margin", [Gross Margin], "Margin %", [Margin %]) ORDER BY [Gross Margin] DESC
note: Non-additive rate: [Margin %] is recomputed per country, never summed. Absolute [Gross Margin] shown alongside.

question: Monthly sales trend for 2024 with year-over-year change
dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(DimDate[YearMonth], DimDate[MonthName], FILTER(ALL(DimDate[Year]), DimDate[Year] = 2024), "Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Sales PY", [Sales PY], "Sales YoY %", [Sales YoY %]) ORDER BY DimDate[YearMonth]
note: Time analysis over DimDate[Date]; YoY compares to 2023 via [Sales PY]. [Sales YoY %] is non-additive.

question: Top 10 products by sales
dax: EVALUATE TOPN(10, SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(DimProduct[ProductName], "Total Sales", [Total Sales]), [Total Sales], DESC) ORDER BY [Total Sales] DESC
note: Ranking -> tabular output with the measure column labeled.

question: Online vs Store split of total sales
dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(FactSales[Channel], "Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Orders", [Orders], "% of Total Sales", [% of Total Sales]) ORDER BY [Total Sales] DESC
note: Breakdown by the leadership dimension the user named; Channel values are Online / Store.

question: What drove the change in Total Sales from 2023 to 2024?
dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(DimProduct[CategoryName], "Sales 2023", CALCULATE([Total Sales], DimDate[Year] = 2023), "Sales 2024", CALCULATE([Total Sales], DimDate[Year] = 2024)) ORDER BY [Sales 2024] DESC
note: Driver-decomposition pattern — decompose the delta across a default dimension; report absolute and % change per member.
